name: Engine
state: Factory 12A rotary, carburetted: a Weber 45 DCOE on a Pierce Manifolds K678 kit. The oil metering pump is disconnected, so the apex seals are oiled by premix in the fuel at every fill.

name: Fuel
state: Weber 45 DCOE, Carter P4070 electric pump, Holley regulator, Duralast FF3429DL filter

name: Ignition
state: Factory breakerless twin-coil (leading and trailing); coils, cap, rotor, wires and plugs renewed

name: Cooling
state: Factory; the coolant has never been fully drained or flushed

name: Electrical
state: Factory 1982 harness, unmodified except previous-owner splices; lead-acid battery in the factory location

name: Lighting
state: Pop-up headlamps; the dash retractor switch is broken and the manual raise knobs work

name: Transmission
state: Factory 3-speed automatic (JATCO 3N71B type); its fluid has never been changed

name: Rear axle and driveline
state: Factory live rear axle and propeller shaft

name: Brakes
state: Factory layout, front discs and rear drums; every friction surface, bearing, seal and wheel cylinder renewed

name: Steering
state: Factory recirculating-ball box with the pre-1983 non-hardened sector shaft

name: Climate
state: Heater and ventilation; the A/C is fitted but barely cools; the blower motor is dead

name: Body and interior
state: Sunbeam Silver; manual windows, no window motors or wiring
